THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: Anu/10/5/4/Rajarata University.
Land and Land Development Ministry Reference No.:

4/3/13/2012/E/38. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land to be acquired:

The allotment of the land in extent of about 3.6447 Hectares shown in Town Survey Preliminary Plan No. 14B additional 161, Paper No. 168 prepared by the Survey Superintendent, situated in the Village of Bandarapuliyankulama in the Sub Division of Nuwaragam Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Nuwaragam Palatha Central, in the District of Anuradhapura.
T.S.P.P. 14B Lot No. 3050
Name of the Land: Puliyankulama Arachaeological Reservation; Claimant: G. A. Somasena; Extent of land: 3.6447 Hectares.
Boundaries:
North: Lot Nos. 2918 and 2921; East: Lot Nos. 2918, 2921 and 259; South: Lot Nos. 259, 3051 and 251;

All persons who have claims for the ownership or any other interest for the above land are requested to meet me on 04th day of November, 2015 at 9.30 a.m. at the Divisional Secretary Office of Nuwaragam Palatha Central. In case of persons who need to make representations on behalf of them, are request to authorize their nominees with a letter of consent for such representations.

In addition, all claimants are requested to submit their claims in duplicate on or before 28th day of October, 2015 giving information on the nature of the claims, justification for the request, required amount of compensation, method of compensation calculation (how was the amount calculated) with plan number and lot number of the land.
G. A. KITHSIRI, Divisional Secretary, Nuwaragam Palatha Central. Divisional Secretariat, Nuwaragam Palatha Central, 21st October, 2015. 11-192

LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT No. 28
OF 1964 (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: DSI/BAMU/LND/01/AQSTN/01.

Land Min. Ref. No.: 4/3/8/2011/PC/263. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964 (Amendment) that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Public Purpose: Acquisition of land for Rathana Piyasa - Center for the Slow Learners and Retired Elders

An allotment of land in Total Extent of about 0.3660 Hectare depicted as Lot No. 01 in the Preliminary Plan No. Ku. 2312 dated 30th July, 2015 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kurunegala, situated in the Village called Aeriyagoda in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 1203 of Pallawadampitiya in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Bamunakotuwa in Kurunegala District of the North-western Province and morefully described as follows:—

SCHEDULE Name of the land: Aeriyagodawatta; Description: Home Garden — 05 Coconut trees (30 to 40 years), 04 Coconut trees, (10-20 years), five permanent Buildings and a well available; Claimant: Mrs. S. M. Khema Ranjanee Jayasundara; Extent: 0.3660 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Bamunakotuwa Divisional Secretariat on 16th December, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 16th December, 2015 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry.
Divisional Secretary, Divisiona/Secretary’s Division, Bamunakotuwa. Divisional Secretariat, Bamunakotuwa, 20th October, 2015. 11-193
